archive.command:
@'
import hashlib,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
local=Path('/mnt/c/Users/10273/Documents/Codex/2026-10-09/task-3')
base=json.loads((local/'V01-V02-independent-acceptance-20261010-ag7xwe18.json').read_text())
supp=json.loads((local/'V01-V02-compatibility-skips-20261010.json').read_text())
work=Path(base['work'])
dest=local/'V01-V02-independent-evidence-20261010-ag7xwe18'
dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sources=[]
for c in base['checks']:
 for k in ('stdout','stderr','junit'):
  if k in c: sources.append(Path(c[k]))
sources.extend(Path(v['path']) for v in supp['files'].values())
manifest={}
for source in sources:
 assert source.parent==work and source.is_file()
 assert source.name.endswith(('.stdout.log','.stderr.log','.xml'))
 target=dest/source.name
 assert not target.exists()
 shutil.copyfile(source,target)
 original=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 actual=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert original==actual
 manifest[source.name]={'source':str(source),'sha256':actual,'bytes':target.stat().st_size}
(dest/'evidence-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
root=Path(base['project_root'])
changes=[]
for rel,h in base['inputs_before']['files'].items():
 p=root/rel
 current=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.is_file() else 'missing'
 if current!=h: changes.append(rel)
print(json.dumps({'copied_files':len(manifest),'destination':str(dest),'mypy_stdout':(dest/'mypy.stdout.log').read_text(),'changed_inputs_final_archive':changes}))
'@ | wsl -d Ubuntu -- /usr/bin/env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /home/zeal/venv313/bin/python -
